vo: Five AI Bots run my store and my agency while I sleep. And they check each other's work.
Most people use AI as separate chats, and end up as the glue between them.
The fix: build a head first. One Chief Bot that every other Bot reports to.
Then one job per Bot. Store. Clients. Content. Leads.
Add a shield: nothing reaches a customer without your OK.
Now put them in one group chat. Store Bot says packs are running low, and Content Bot holds the pack video on its own.
At eight, the plan is waiting. You just say yes.
But one switch breaks all of it. It's tip three in the full video.
